HKEX.hours: The sessions and the lunch break are HKEX's. A day ends at 16:10 and a half day at 12:10, the latest its closing auction ends, as Yahoo's full days do; Yahoo's half days end at 12:06, before the auction can.

yearSources.2026: Published by ASX at the source; its early closes in ASX notice 1245.26.10 (https://asxonline.com/content/asxonline/public/notices/2026/october/1245.26.10.html).
yearSources.2027: Published by ASX at the source and in ASX notice 1097.26.09 (https://asxonline.com/content/asxonline/public/notices/2026/september/1097.26.09.html); its early closes on 24 and 31 December at the times ASX has set every year since 2021.
yearSources.2028: Derived, not yet published by ASX: its rules as it applied them in 2022 for January and in 2023 from March, the years with the same weekdays: New Year's Day on a Saturday closes Monday 3 January, ANZAC Day on a Tuesday closes, and Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve on a Sunday close nothing early (ASX notice 1136.23.11). Clock changes from Australia/Sydney's rules.

ASX.hours: The open is ASX's. A day ends at 16:12, as Yahoo's do, a minute after its closing auction, and a half day at 14:12, the same minute after its own; Yahoo's half days end at 14:21, ten minutes after the auction.

yearSources.2026: Published by Deutsche Börse at the source; the last trading day's 14:00 close in its announcement (https://www.cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/5673886/22764993c4b1617c5f465186066344e6/data/Final%20trading%20session%202026.pdf).
yearSources.2027: Holidays published by Deutsche Börse at the source and in its 2027 trading calendar, which marks 30 December's hours as differing (https://cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/5674438/fb6e22c77930acea97641cf7d65ef78a/data/deutsche-boerse-trading-calendar-2027.pdf). yearSources.2028: Holidays published by Deutsche Börse at the source, as changes for future years are not excluded. XETRA.hours: A day ends at 17:30 and the last trading day at 14:00, when the closing auction starts, as Yahoo's do.

yearSources.2026: Published by Deutsche Börse at the source: shares end at 20:00 on the public holidays it trades, Ascension Day, Whit Monday and Corpus Christi; the last trading day's 14:00 close in its announcement (https://www.cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/5673886/22764993c4b1617c5f465186066344e6/data/Final%20trading%20session%202026.pdf).
yearSources.2027: Holidays published by Deutsche Börse at the source and in its 2027 trading calendar, which marks Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi and 30 December as days whose hours differ (https://cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/5674438/fb6e22c77930acea97641cf7d65ef78a/data/deutsche-boerse-trading-calendar-2027.pdf). yearSources.2028: Holidays published by Deutsche Börse at the source, as changes for future years are not excluded. Derived, not yet published: 20:00 closes on the public holidays it trades, Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi and German Unity Day, by the source's rule, and the last trading day, Friday 29 December, closing at 14:00, as on Friday 29 December 2023 (http://cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/3735776/e53cb5552fd069e20dc3faaf343c9c2d/data/Final%20trading%20session%202023.pdf). Clock changes from Europe/Berlin's rules.

FRA.hours: Börse Frankfurt's: 08:00 to 22:00, as Yahoo's days are, and 20:00 on a public holiday it trades, when Yahoo's trades end though its 2026 days say 22:00.

yearSources.2026: Published by OTC Markets at the source. Its early closes end the regular session at 13:00, as its OTC Link ECN FIX Specification says of shortened days (https://www.otcmarkets.com/files/OTC%20Link%20ECN%20FIX%20Specification.pdf); the 14:00 at the source is OTC Link's extended hours.
yearSources.2027: Published by OTC Markets at the source, its early closes as in 2026.
yearSources.2028: Derived, not yet published by OTC Markets: its 2026 and 2027 holidays and its rule for early closes, on the days New York's exchanges publish for 2028 (https://www.nyse.com/trade/hours-calendars), New Year's Day on a Saturday closing nothing. Clock changes from America/New_York's rules.

OTC.hours: The session and the early closes are OTC Markets'. The pre-market from 04:00 and the after-hours to 20:00 are Yahoo's trading periods for over-the-counter stocks; OTC Markets publishes none.
